the marine evaporites in the Fortuna basin (SE Spain) are older than the Messinian Salinty Crisis, which was dated to the C3r Chron (late Messinian) by previous authors.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

The main takeaway from our work is that
the marine evaporites of the Fortuna Basin were deposited during the late Tortonian to Messinian transition (late Miocene), not in the early Messinial (late Miocene) as has been previously thought.
